decisions.rationale: Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (particularly DEB pruriginosa) is a subtype of dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa.
Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (EBP) is a subtype of dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa.
Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is not related to the provided leaf label 'Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa'.
